# Skill: run-playwright-security-e2e-tests

**When to use:** Run only Playwright specs tagged @security (for example xss-security.spec.ts).

## Scope
- `realworld/specs/e2e`
- `package.json`

## Prerequisites
- Same as run-playwright-e2e-tests: setup complete and SPA running at baseURL

## Steps
1. Start the SPA dev server.
2. Run bun run test:e2e:security (playwright test --grep @security).

## Existing example
- `package.json test:e2e:security; .github/workflows/security-tests.yml.`
